scope: Source-difference tangent diagnostics only; no finite motion or energy prediction
limitations: Cartesian interpolation is not a covalent-preserving path
Projection is local load, not finite work or a relaxed-state energy
Waters and target/spectators are not part of the protein-difference direction
Waters are grouped only within each source; no cross-source water matching
Frozen-f electronic state, fixed occupancy and absent bulk solvent remain
No Hessian, state populations, force correction or new derivative qualification

alignment.rule: equal weight all exactly mapped common protein heavy atoms

Hans8DQ2.direction: toward other Hans source after rigid alignment
Hans8DQ2.normalization: Local loads use each subset's Euclidean displacement norm; additive contributions use the whole-protein norm. Only additive contributions sum to total.

Hans8FNR.direction: toward other Hans source after rigid alignment
Hans8FNR.normalization: Local loads use each subset's Euclidean displacement norm; additive contributions use the whole-protein norm. Only additive contributions sum to total.
